newsitem.title: CANADA: Placer to buy Etruscan shrs from Echo.
newsitem.headline: Placer to buy Etruscan shrs from Echo.

text.p: Placer Dome Inc said Thursday it plans to buy 4.2 million shares in Nova Scotia-based Etruscan Enterprises Ltd from Echo Bay Mines.
Placer said it will hold a 24.3 percent stake in Etruscan. The shares are being bought in a private deal and terms were not disclosed. Placer said the stake was being acquired as an investment.
Placer and Etruscan have reached an agreement on the exploration and possible development of the Samira gold deposit in Niger.
A Placer spokesman said the gold miner previously held no shares in Etruscan and viewed the purchase as a way to gain control of the Niger property.

The Etruscan shares were valued at C$4 apiece in the deal or about C$16 million in total but the amount Placer paid to Echo was reduced to C$10 million because Placer gave up its stake in an Idaho gold property it shared with Echo.
Placer sold its 49 percent stake in the Kilgore exploration property in Idaho to Echo Bay, which held 51 percent, for C$6 million.
